verdict.rationale: Patent Center's own documentation shows its APIs carry version levels: an update required direct API callers of Workbench/view applications to change API versions. That is first-party evidence of API versioning, but the pack contains no documented deprecation policy for those APIs. The TEAS form retirement notice concerns web forms, not APIs, so it is not credited. The developer portal's machine docs were unreadable without JavaScript. Missing for 10: a published API deprecation policy (notice periods, sunset timelines), a versioning scheme across api.uspto.gov, readable API docs, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy

citations.quote: For users making direct API calls to Workbench/view applications, this update required a change to the version level of the APIs within Workbench/view applications.
